The pagination command fails to detect existing sign-off issues beyond the first page and can create duplicates. The shared incompleteness flag also produces materially false reporting when only error details are missing.

Full review comments:

- [P2] Parse all paginated issue pages correctly — C:\repo\skills\review-loop\SKILL.md:678-682
  When the repository has more than 100 open issues, `gh api --paginate` emits each response page sequentially; it does not merge array pages into one JSON array. The resulting file contains adjacent arrays, so `JSON.parse` fails, `LOOKUP_FAILED` is set, and the loop creates a duplicate sign-off issue even when the canonical issue exists on a later page. Use `--slurp` and flatten the page arrays, or process each page as it is emitted.

- [P2] Distinguish missing error text from a missing report — C:\repo\skills\review-loop\SKILL.md:931-936
  On an `error` termination where `report.md` is valid but `error.txt` is missing, the body builder sets `BODY_INCOMPLETE`, causing this warning to claim that the run report could not be read and that the record carries little else. The record actually contains the full report and its own missing-error warning, so the session reports the wrong failure. Persist separate report/error completeness flags or select the warning based on which input failed.
